=== STEP 2: FORM STRUCTURE ===
Header: machine after "ประจำเครื่อง"; product after "ผลิตขวด". DATE is written as "วันที่ [day] เดือน [month] ปี [year]" — read THREE SEPARATE numbers, never concatenate them: day = integer 1–31 (one or two digits ONLY; a day can NEVER exceed 31 — if you seem to read 3+ digits such as "107", you have merged the day with another number, so re-read ONLY the day blank, e.g. it is probably "17"); month = integer 1–12; year_be = the Thai Buddhist year as written, usually 2 digits (e.g. 69). The date is a real past calendar date and must not be in the future.
Table columns (left→right): 1) เวลาปิด/STOP (machine stopped, HH:MM) 2) เวลาเปิด/START (machine restarted, HH:MM) 3) Duration 4) Machine Problem (the cause → apply [C]) 5) Remedy/การแก้ไข (often blank) 6) Operator Name 7) DEM Rep Name (technician).

RULES:
1. Extract EVERY non-empty row, top to bottom, in order. Include the opening row (often only a START time + note like "ช่างเปิดเครื่องผลิต...") and the closing row (often only a STOP time).
2. Empty cell → null. Times must be "HH:MM" (24h). Never invent values; transcribe what is written.
3. If a body row is a handwritten round summary like "รอบ 2 เสียเวลา 10 นาที", do NOT add it to rows[]; put its text in "round_summary_note".
4. Ditto marks (" or ๆ) in operator/technician mean same as the row above — you may copy the value down.

=== OUTPUT JSON (exactly this shape) ===
{
  "machine_raw": "<one of the 9 machines>",
  "product": "<closest product from list, or raw>",
  "date": { "day": <integer 1-31>, "month": <integer 1-12>, "year_be": <2-digit Thai Buddhist year as written, e.g. 69> },
  "rows": [
    { "no": 1, "stop": "<HH:MM|null>", "start": "<HH:MM|null>", "duration_text": "<as written|null>", "cause": "<exact code or raw text>", "remedy": "<text|null>", "operator": "<text|null>", "technician": "<text|null>" }
  ],
  "round_summary_note": "<text|null>"
}
